content_blocks.text: The autumn leaves had fallen, leaving the backyard bare and cold. In the corner of the garden, a single ivy leaf clung tenaciously to the wall, its vibrant green color a stark contrast to the drab surroundings. Sarah stood beneath it, her eyes fixed on the leaf as if it held the answer to all her problems. She had always believed that the last leaf would hold onto the wall until she was cured, a superstition she clung to in her darkest moments. As she watched, the leaf swayed gently in the breeze, but did not fall. Hope flickered within her once again.
